newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACCC clears Woolworths petrol deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACCC clears Woolworths petrol deal.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) said on Friday it would not oppose a plan by retailer Woolworths Ltd to offer discount petrol to customers buying at least A$30 of groceries at some of its supermarkets.
"The ACCC has reviewed Woolworths' proposal and is satisfied that the public benefits (including lower petrol prices) outweigh any public detriment," acting chairman Allan Asher said in a statement.
"The ACCC has welcomed Woolworths entry into petrol retailing as it is consistent with the ACCC's recent petroleum report which called for increased competition and new entry," Asher said.
